scripts.start: pnpm run config:dev && pnpm prebuild && firebase use santas-workshop-test && ng serve santashop-app --configuration=development --port=4100
scripts.start:test: pnpm run config:test && pnpm prebuild && firebase use santas-workshop-test && ng serve santashop-app --configuration=development --port=4100
scripts.build:test: pnpm run config:test && pnpm prebuild && ng build santashop-app --configuration=development
scripts.build:prod: pnpm run config:prod && pnpm prebuild && ng build santashop-app --configuration=production
scripts.deploy:test: pnpm run config:test && firebase use santas-workshop-test && firebase target santashop-app && ng build santashop-app --configuration=development && firebase deploy
scripts.deploy:test:hosting: pnpm run config:test && firebase use santas-workshop-test && firebase target santashop-app && ng build santashop-app --configuration=development && firebase deploy --only hosting
